currentFocus: Preparing the October 27 Soft Alpha: verified players can reserve characters; account-level Early Access and a closed-by-default public gameplay gate control when play begins.

currentChange.summary: Add a closed-by-default gameplay gate, account-wide Early Access, audited Operator Console controls, and launch/waiting presentation.

latestCompleted.summary: Introduced verified Player identities and pre-alpha character reservations: email verification and up to three reserved character names per account.

nextStep: Human review of the access gate and production preflight; public gameplay remains closed until an operator deliberately opens it.

highlights.summary: Deep Jag is playable: brace the cave-in for Tansy, mine Galvanite behind it, and refine Galvanic Stock and Galvaferrite at the Processing Yard.
Added Rusk Recovery and 10,000 Hours: Wade's own yard, a workbench that practises Welding indefinitely for scrap, and the Clean Pass moment every weld now rolls.
Added Map MISSION and TURN IN destinations, blue turn-in guidance, compact Mission strips at the top of Play, and visible keyboard focus on beveled controls.
